meta.title: La Raminga · Valentina's home cooking
meta.description: Home restaurant, private chef and meals to take home in Lunigiana, Italy. Seasonal, handmade dishes straight from the garden.

hero.title: la raminga
hero.subtitle: Seasonal, handmade cooking. Hand-rolled pasta, vegetables from the garden, Italian flavours mingling with scents I've picked up travelling. More an experience than a dinner.

about.title: Hi, I'm Valentina
about.p1: I grew up in Bergamo, travelled a lot, and now I live in Lunigiana. I've worked as a cook for years, with plenty of other jobs in between, but cooking is the one thing I always come back to: when I'm happy, when I'm sad, in a tent over a fire, on holiday, anywhere.
about.p2: La Raminga is my way of opening my home to people who want to eat well and stick around for a chat. No restaurant, no big numbers: just thoughtful cooking, a few seats, and time at the table.
about.p3: I'm vegetarian myself, but I cook meat and fish too. At my table you'll find a bit of everything.

cuisine.title: How I cook
cuisine.lead: Bold, colourful, handmade. Seasonal, and as close to home as I can manage.
cuisine.body1: Everything's made by hand: fresh pasta, ravioli, gnocchi, focaccia, crackers, baked desserts, crêpes. Vegetables lead the way. The wild herbs and whatever's ready in the garden out back set the menu for the week, along with whatever idea I happen to be chasing.
cuisine.body2: I love mixing the Italian dishes I grew up with (parmigiana, pasta alla Norma, lemon risotto) with flavours from further east: ginger, soy, grains, legumes. Every now and then I'll throw a themed night: a full-on spicy dinner, a vegetarian burger evening, or a big shared spread with focaccia and fried polenta for mopping up the sauce.
cuisine.body3: Vegan menus are no problem. Gluten-free, we can work out together. Intolerances I can handle. For serious allergies, though, I can't guarantee an allergen-free kitchen, so it helps to give me a heads-up in advance.

items.title: Home restaurant
items.body: Come over for dinner. Indoors when it's cold, out on the terrace with a mountain view when the weather plays along. Up to eight guests.
details: A new four-course menu every week
1/2L wine, water, coffee and amaro included
Pets welcome (just let me know in advance)

items.title: Private chef
items.body: I come to you. I do the shopping, cooking, serving, washing up and tidying. You just look after your guests.
details: At least a week's notice, please

items.title: Schisete · ready meals
items.body: Home-cooked meals to take away, fresh or frozen. We agree on a budget and put the menu together.
details: A menu built around your tastes

garden.title: The garden
garden.p1: The vegetable garden is right behind the house, and I tend it together with the neighbours. From June and July onwards, the first harvest goes straight onto the plate.
garden.p2: A garden teaches you things: patience, the unexpected, the insects, the wind, the work. When a vegetable goes from seed to plate, the circle closes. Anything I don't grow myself comes from small local producers: flour from the mill down the road, eggs from the neighbours.
